_about: Optional golden questions for library_update.py. After a candidate index is built, each question whose "doc" is the publication being updated is run through the same hybrid retrieval the assistant uses; the update is refused unless the top 5 results include a passage of that publication whose section label contains "section_contains" (case-insensitive). Add entries for the passages whose answers matter most, for example {"question": "...", "doc": "DAFMAN 48-123", "section_contains": "para 6.12"}. The labels are the ones shown in the assistant's citations. Questions must not contain personal information.
